reference_fields: O. C. Roberts and J. F. Anderson
Fruit Notes Volume 18, February 15, 1953 archive article describing newer pear varieties for Massachusetts growers

categories.name: Massachusetts pear variety notes from Fruit Notes 1953
categories.description: Fruit Notes gives brief Massachusetts-oriented descriptions of newer pear varieties, including fruit appearance, eating quality, storage behavior, and source harvest timing

extractors.category: Massachusetts pear variety notes from Fruit Notes 1953

rows.name: Cayuga
rows.description: Fruit Notes describes Cayuga as a medium-sized greenish-yellow pear with a light blush, fairly attractive appearance, good quality, and thick tough skin

rows.name: Clyde
rows.description: Fruit Notes describes Clyde as much like Seckel in color and shape but considerably larger, with only fair quality but good keeping ability

rows.name: Cope's Seedless
rows.description: Fruit Notes describes Cope's Seedless as a medium-sized yellowish-green, attractive, good-quality pear with juicy fine-grained flesh, some tendency to russet, and few seeds

rows.name: Covert
rows.harvest_time: latter part of September or early October
rows.description: Fruit Notes describes Covert as a large green pear that is fairly attractive, good quality, juicy, and keeps well in storage

rows.name: Ewart
rows.description: Fruit Notes describes Ewart as a large yellowish-green pear with unattractive appearance, good quality, juicy fine-grained flesh, and thick skin

rows.name: Ovid
rows.description: Fruit Notes describes Ovid as a medium-sized yellowish-green pear with a light blush, fairly attractive appearance, good quality, tendency to russet, thick skin, and good storage behavior

rows.name: Phelps
rows.description: Fruit Notes describes Phelps as a medium-sized yellowish-green pear that is unattractive, fair quality, rather acid, and keeps well in storage

rows.name: Pulteney
rows.description: Fruit Notes describes Pulteney as a medium-sized yellowish-green pear with unattractive appearance, fine-grained flesh, fair quality, moderate juiciness, tart flavor, and good storage behavior

rows.name: Waite
rows.description: Fruit Notes describes Waite as a medium-sized greenish-yellow pear that is fairly attractive but only fair quality, not juicy, and tends toward core browning

rows.name: Willard
rows.description: Fruit Notes describes Willard as a large green pear that is unattractive, fair quality, juicy, coarse-fleshed, and prone to shriveling in storage
